title: Affine-base flat quasi-finite polynomial chart core
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sbc-cohen-macaulay-flat-quasi-finite-chart, there exist n, an open O containing y, an affine open V of T, and a flat locally quasi-finite locally finitely presented map e: O → AffineSpace_n(V) whose projection followed by V's inclusion equals O.ι followed by f.

source.place: Tag 00RH, affine localization, polynomial factorization and flat shrinking (Tags 00QE, 00RE, 00R7, 00RC).

proof.text: Choose affine neighborhoods and translate the flat finitely presented morphism to rings. Apply the quasi-finite polynomial factorization, the fibre flatness criterion using the depth equality, and openness of the flat locus; transport the resulting localized ring map back to schemes.

theorem exists_affine_base_flat_quasiFinite_chart_core
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)]
    (y : X) (ht : f y ∈ U)
    (hdepth :
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (O : X.Opens) (V : T.Opens)
      (_ : IsAffine V.toScheme)
      (e : O.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) V.toScheme),
      y ∈ O ∧ Flat e ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite e ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation e ∧
        e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) V.toScheme ↘ V.toScheme) ≫ V.ι =
          O.ι ≫ f
